name: Omaezaki (Japan, city)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Omaezaki city emblem in orange, blue and white: a disc of orange above and blue below with a white stylised swoosh.
history: Municipal flag of Omaezaki, a city in Shizuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 April 2005; the emblem dates from 1 August 2004.

features.role: Omaezaki city emblem — a disc of orange above and blue below with a white stylised swoosh
